胡九郎看着站在门口的杨童，眼底闪过一丝诧异，嘴角的笑意带着几分无奈。昨夜临别时，杨童那句“希望我们不会再见面”还清晰在耳，此刻人却已然站在卦铺门口，一身干练的劲装未换，眉宇间带着几分凝重，显然不是专程来寒暄的。

杨童走进卦铺，目光扫过桌上还没收拾的粥碗，又落在范梦雪身上，随即转向胡九郎。

“抱歉，胡先生，昨夜是我唐突了。我也没想到，会这么快又来打扰你。”

范梦雪连忙搬来一张椅子，热情地招呼道：“杨姐姐快坐，师兄，你快给杨姐姐倒杯茶呀！”说着，便要转身去厨房，却被杨童抬手拦住了。

“不用麻烦师妹了，我来这里，是有正事要找胡先生。”

杨童的目光重新落回胡九郎身上，凝重感更浓。

“我们把冷欣和苏笑笑带回749局后，连夜进行了审讯，也对她们身上的气息做了探查，发现了一些不对劲的地方。”

胡九郎心中一凛，收敛了神色。

“哦？什么不对劲？是冷欣的蛊虫，还是苏笑笑身上有异常？”

“都有。冷欣的本命蛊虫，除了能嗅到陆明的气息，还检测到了一丝极淡的邪异之气，和我们之前在夜月村、莫奇卫抓捕现场发现的气息，隐隐有些相似，但又更隐蔽、更诡异，不仔细探查根本发现不了。我们带冷欣去了灵隐寺和夜月村，让她进行了对比！”

杨童顿了顿，又道：

“还有苏笑笑，她看似只是个普通的目击者，可我们在她身上检测到了微弱的阵法波动，不是玄门正统的阵法，更像是……被人强行种下的印记，像是某种追踪符，却又比追踪符更隐蔽，像是通过她，追踪我们所有人。”

“追踪印记？难怪我们从桃源古镇回来后，总觉得心神不宁，原来对方早就留下了后手，借着苏笑笑，监视我们的动向。”

范梦雪站在一旁，脸上的笑意早已消失，眼底满是严肃，说道：

Hu Jiulang looked at Yang Tong standing at the door, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and the smile on his lips was a little helpless.When parting last night, Yang Tong's words "I hope we won't meet again" were still clear in my ears. At this moment, he was already standing at the door of Gua Pu. He was still wearing smart clothes and had a dignified look on his brows. It was obvious that he had not come here specifically to exchange greetings.

Yang Tong walked into the Gua Shop, his eyes glanced at the porridge bowls on the table that had not been cleared away, then fell on Fan Mengxue, and then turned to Hu Jiulang.

"Sorry, Mr. Hu, I was abrupt last night. I didn't expect that I would bother you again so soon."

Fan Mengxue quickly moved a chair and greeted warmly: "Sister Yang, sit down quickly. Senior brother, hurry up and give Sister Yang a cup of tea!" After saying that, he turned around to go to the kitchen, but Yang Tong raised his hand to stop her.

"There's no need to trouble Junior Sister. I'm here because I have business to see Mr. Hu."

Yang Tong's eyes fell back on Hu Jiulang, feeling even more solemn.

"After we brought Leng Xin and Su Xiaoxiao back to Bureau 749, we interrogated them overnight. We also checked their auras and found something wrong."

Hu Jiulang felt a chill in his heart and calmed down.

"Oh? What's wrong? Is it Leng Xin's Gu, or is there something abnormal about Su Xiaoxiao?"

"Both. Leng Xin's natal Gu, in addition to being able to smell Lu Ming's breath, also detected a very faint evil aura. It is vaguely similar to the aura we found at the Yeyue Village and Moqiwei capture sites before, but it is more hidden and weird. It cannot be found without careful inspection. We took Leng Xin to Lingyin Temple and Yeyue Village and asked her to compare!"

Yang Tong paused and then said:

"And Su Xiaoxiao, she seems to be just an ordinary witness, but we detected weak formation fluctuations on her body. It is not an orthodox Xuanmen formation, but more like... a mark forcibly planted by someone, like some kind of tracking talisman, but more hidden than the tracking talisman. It seems like she is tracking all of us through her."

"Tracking marks? No wonder we always feel uneasy after returning from Taoyuan Ancient Town. It turns out that the other party has already left a back-up plan to monitor our movements through Su Xiaoxiao."
